text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Nakayama Kinen, Air 
Groove came to give Duramente some 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove admits that she tends to worry 
too much about Duramente, still seeing her 
as the young child she once was.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente promised that her run today 
would completely overturn that impression.
